source_name: NBRSM — Македонска платежна инфраструктура (Macedonian Payment Infrastructure)
why_relevant: Structural map of the national payment infrastructure (MIPS, KIBS, card schemes, processors). Best single page for actor mapping and for snowballing to non-central-bank operators relevant to ATM/POS estate analysis.

source_name: NBRSM — Национален совет за платните системи (National Payment System Council)
why_relevant: Multi-stakeholder council (central bank, banks, Treasury, card/processing actors) whose agendas, strategies and minutes reveal forward-looking payments initiatives (instant payments, card scheme moves, cash strategy) before they appear in statistics. Also a strong actor-map pointer. A national payment system development strategy PDF is published under /WBStorage/Files/.

source_name: NBRSM — Менувачници (registry of licensed exchange offices)
why_relevant: Register of licensed currency exchange offices supervised by the central bank — an indirect indicator of cash-handling intensity and of the physical cash economy footprint, relevant to cash-usage trend analysis.

source_name: uslugi.gov.mk — national e-services catalogue
why_relevant: Catalogue of state e-services per institution, incl. Central Registry entries; useful for enumerating exactly which registry/tax data services exist, their fees and their legal basis, and for spotting new digital-payment-enabled public services.

source_name: Отворена влада / ОВП портал (Open Government Partnership North Macedonia) — procurement-as-open-data commitment
why_relevant: Documents the government's binding commitments on publishing procurement as open data, including planned API/bulk releases from ЕСЈН. Tells the collector what data is due to become available and when — a forward-looking pointer that changes collection strategy.

source_name: ДЗС eStat / statistical business register services
why_relevant: SSO's user-services entry point (incl. requests for tailored tabulations and business-register-based counts of active enterprises by NKD activity, e.g. financial services and retail) — the route to breakdowns not in the public tables.

source_name: Регистар на организации на потрошувачи (nvosorabotka.gov.mk) + Министерство за економија и труд consumer-protection pages
why_relevant: State-maintained listing of registered consumer organisations — the authoritative way to enumerate consumer bodies beyond ОПМ (regional/local ones) rather than guessing at them. The ministry's consumer-protection section documents the institutional framework and which body handles which grievance type.

source_name: Министерство за финансии — Е-јавни набавки / Биро за јавни набавки pages
why_relevant: Ministry-level entry point that defines the legal frame, links ЕСЈН and БЈН, and is itself a contracting authority for treasury/payment-system procurement. Useful as an authoritative pointer and for tracking legal changes that alter what gets published.

source_name: МФ — Регистар на јавни субјекти (Register of Public Entities)
why_relevant: Authoritative list of public-sector entities; used to scope which bodies are in the Open Finance transaction universe and to resolve institution names appearing in payment/procurement records.

source_name: yellowpages.com.mk - MK company directory
why_relevant: Second independent MK directory useful for cross-checking vendor existence, addresses and category tagging (security/CIT firms, IT integrators, fiscal-device servicers) when a vendor has no web presence.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Проверка и резервација на име на субјект (name search)
why_relevant: Free public name-search endpoint; a practical zero-cost way to confirm whether a payments/fintech brand exists as a registered MK entity and to discover exact legal names before paid lookups.

source_name: CompanyWall / ABV.mk business directories — КИБС АД Скопје and КаСис АД profiles
why_relevant: Commercial aggregators that resurface Central Registry financials (revenue, headcount, blocked-account status) for free or cheaply, giving a fast first read on operator scale and year-on-year trend before paying for official filings.

source_name: Здружение на трговијата при Стопанска комора на СМ (Trade Association)
why_relevant: Unites wholesale and retail legal entities — i.e. the merchant/acceptance side of card payments. Explicitly mandated to propose legislative measures and advocate regulatory change, which is where merchant complaints about card acceptance fees, cash-limit rules and fiscalisation surface. Chairman and secretary contacts are published, enabling actor mapping.

source_name: Здружение на финансиски организации при Стопанска комора на СМ
why_relevant: Described as the only organisational form uniting all financial-sector actors — banks, insurers, pension fund managers, non-bank financial companies, leasing companies and savings houses. Broader membership than the banking association alone, so it resolves the non-bank payments/credit periphery relevant to card and cash behaviour.

source_name: AAG — ranking of most-read web portals in North Macedonia
why_relevant: Audience-measurement style listing of the most-read MK web portals: lets this cell prioritise media monitoring by reach rather than guesswork, and enumerates outlets not yet in the source register.

source_name: Western Union / MoneyGram / Ria agent pages of MK banks (Halkbank, Komercijalna, Stopanska, Sparkasse, TTK)
why_relevant: Bank pages disclose which global MTO each institution is agent for, the number of payout points (e.g. Halkbank as WU agent across 38 branches; TTK as MoneyGram agent), currencies and fee schedules — a cheap way to map the MTO-to-distributor matrix and pricing without paying for it.

source_name: AmCham North Macedonia member directory
why_relevant: Member profiles (Asseco SEE among them) give verified legal entity names, addresses and business-line descriptions for technology vendors operating in MK - a clean seed list for the vendor actor map. The Macedonian-Bulgarian chamber (mbcham.org) plays the same role for security/cash firms.

source_name: eCommerce4all.mk — e-payment / online transaction processing knowledge base
why_relevant: Practitioner-oriented guide enumerating which processors, gateways and banks an MK merchant can actually contract with, and the onboarding steps. Useful pointer for discovering smaller PSPs and acquirer arrangements not visible in regulator lists.

source_name: eCommerce4all.mk — E-payment processing / acquiring bank overview (Асоцијација за е-трговија)
why_relevant: Industry-association explainer naming the MK acquiring banks (Halkbank, Stopanska, NLB, Komercijalna, UNIBanka) and the fee stack merchants face — a useful actor map and sanity check when reading bank acquiring terms.

entity_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine CDX API
source_name: Wayback Machine — archived MK commercial bank tariff books and card fee pages (Komercijalna, Stopanska, NLB, Halkbank etc.)
why_relevant: Bank tariff books ('Тарифник за надоместоци', 'Одлука за тарифа') and card/POS fee pages are routinely overwritten with each revision; the archive is the only way to build a time series of MK card issuing/acquiring fees, ATM withdrawal charges and POS merchant service charges. Same CDX pattern that proved productive on nbrm.mk should apply per bank domain.

source_name: Wikipedia — List of supermarket chains in North Macedonia
why_relevant: Cheap seed roster of the large grocery chains (Tinex, Vero, KAM, Ramstore, Stokomak et al.) needed to build the merchant-acceptance census; each entry snowballs to a corporate site, payment page and store count.

source_name: mk.wikipedia — Платен промет / Македонски Интербанкарски Платен Систем
why_relevant: Not a statistics source, but an efficient glossary and actor-map bootstrap in Macedonian: correct official names, the МИПС/КИБС division of labour (MIPS for large-value and above-1-million-denar or real-time payments; KIBS for retail), and outbound citations to NBRM primary pages.

source_name: Слободен пристап (slobodenpristap.mk) — FOI request platform, and АСПИ (Агенција за заштита на правото на слободен пристап до информации од јавен карактер)
why_relevant: Where ЕСЈН hides contract attachments or a state-owned entity does not publish, a Freedom-of-Information request under the Macedonian FOI law is a lawful escalation. The platform publishes past requests and responses, and АСПИ maintains the register of information holders — including the appeals commission and financial bodies — with named FOI officers.

source_name: Balkan Tender Watch — North Macedonia country section
why_relevant: Regional civil-society procurement watch aggregating Macedonian cases, legal analyses and links to national monitoring bodies. Good snowball source for further actors and for cross-border comparison of ATM/POS tender practice across the Western Balkans.

entity_name: Consultancy market-report vendors covering MK e-commerce and payments
source_name: Consultancy market-report vendors covering MK e-commerce and payments (Mordor Intelligence, ResearchAndMarkets, Verified Market Research)
why_relevant: These vendors publish MK-specific e-commerce/payments sizing and payment-method mix that circulate widely as the de facto commercial view (e.g. cards ~46% of 2024 e-commerce payment share with wallets growing fast; cash-on-delivery cited at ~70% of purchases; MK e-commerce ~USD 0.6bn in 2024). Their table-of-contents and sample pages are free and reveal which underlying MK sources they rely on — valuable as pointers even when the report itself is unaffordable.

source_name: European Commission - North Macedonia financial assistance under IPA
why_relevant: Authoritative index of IPA II/III programming documents and action fiches for MK; action fiches describe baseline market conditions (e.g. digital public services, PFM, e-payments) and the budget behind them.

source_name: MoneyGet (Asseco independent ATM network) - regional sites as MK proxy
why_relevant: Independent/white-label ATM network brand operated across SEE; partner and locations pages enumerate deployed ATMs and partner merchants. Useful to test whether an IAD (independent ATM deployer) layer exists in MK, which materially changes ATM-count interpretation of central-bank statistics.

entity_name: Payments-industry vendor explainers on MK local payment methods
source_name: Payments-industry vendor explainers on MK local payment methods (Transfi, PayAtlas, EcommerceBridge)
why_relevant: PSP-facing country guides that enumerate MK acquirers, card schemes accepted, local payment methods, compliance requirements and fee norms — operational detail absent from official statistics. They also carry recent market claims (MK e-commerce EUR 213m in Q1 2025, cross-border shopping +32%, digital transactions +21% in 2024) that flag where to look for primary confirmation.

source_name: zk.mk business directory - software / banking / ATM categories
why_relevant: Macedonian yellow-pages style directory with category listings for software firms, banks and ATM locations; a cheap way to enumerate candidate vendors, integrators and terminal distributors that never appear in English search results.

entity_name: Асоцијација на финансиски друштва на Северна Македонија
source_name: Асоцијација на финансиски друштва на Северна Македонија (AFD)
why_relevant: Membership body for financial-technology and other non-bank financial companies serving residents of North Macedonia; publishes member-accession news (e.g. Кредит Јес joining in 2021). Resolves the non-bank lender/fintech population that competes with card credit and cash.

entity_name: Бизнис конфедерација на Северна Македонија / Business Confederation of North Macedonia
source_name: Бизнис конфедерација на Северна Македонија / Business Confederation of North Macedonia (BCM)
why_relevant: Employers' confederation (organisation of employers), a social-partner voice distinct from the chambers, active in UN Global Compact since 2015. Employer-side positions on cash payments, wage payment channels and informal economy intersect directly with cash-usage questions.

entity_name: Сојуз на стопански комори на Македонија
source_name: Сојуз на стопански комори на Македонија (Union of Chambers of Commerce, chamber.mk)
why_relevant: Second national chamber umbrella (independent, non-governmental) describing itself as connecting thousands of member companies with 1000+ national and international institutions. A parallel membership population and a distinct lobbying voice from mchamber.mk — needed so the merchant/SME population is not under-counted.
